summary: Connection work per the owner's pivot away from design. The tournament identity path adapted to the game's real Discord login: the committed OTOMO CHAIN tree shows the pre-entry export carrying verified discord_id while the reward export still lacks it, so the dashboard now resolves identities through a two-pass, strength-ordered resolver — a record's own discord_id first (future-proof, validated as a snowflake), then the pre-entry roster, then confirmed links, then link codes — with rows settled by stronger sources excluded from code matching so a stray code in a verified player's profile cannot drag others into ambiguity (a defect the new test exposed before it shipped). The payout route reports each grant's identity source. A stones connection joined it: POST /api/admin/tournament/stones grants MAGATAMA across the pre-entry roster with operator-supplied amount and season, dry-run default, idempotent keys, and NOT_REGISTERED_YET withholding that resolves itself on rerun after a player's first dashboard login. OTOMO_CHAIN_PREENTRY_URL joins the env surface, all fetches remain HTTPS-only with the admin secret, and a set-state-in-effect lint error in the concurrent session's 推しGODS picker was fixed in place. 84 tests, lint, typecheck and build pass; unauth 403 and the recent-auth gate verified live.
